description: Use Garry Tan's exact Claude Code setup: 23 opinionated tools that serve as CEO, Designer, Eng Manager, Release Manager, Doc Engineer, and QA
vibe: Ship like a CEO, debug like a detective, and never let a green CI lie to you.
highlights: 23 opinionated specialist skills that map to real org roles (CEO, Eng Manager, Designer, QA, Release) rather than generic 'assistant' personas.
Validation discipline enforces a strict order: inventory failures, diagnose before changing code, reproduce with the smallest test, then run cheap CI before paid work.
Explicit anti-cheating rules: 'Do not lower thresholds, increase model budgets, skip cases, or rejudge a failure to manufacture a pass.'
Safety skills (/careful, /freeze, /guard) provide hard blocks on destructive commands and directory-scoped edits, not just warnings.
Browser skills default to the user's real logged-in Aside browser, falling back to headless Chromium only when necessary — respecting real sessions over synthetic ones.
assessment: This file treats AI agents as accountable engineering roles with explicit failure taxonomies, not as autocomplete. The validation discipline section is unusually rigorous — it distinguishes product defects from test-expectation defects from environment failures, and forbids the classic AI shortcut of weakening tests to get green. The result is a workflow that optimizes for trustworthy signal over fast-looking progress, which is exactly what production teams need from agent tooling.
